title: Saffron Makhana Kheer
steps: Add 1 litre toned milk to a heavy-bottomed kadai and cook on low flame to reduce.
Keep stirring continuously for around 10–15 minutes. This is important because the milk can stick to the bottom if you don’t keep stirring.
Mix 2 tbsp skimmed milk powder with a little water to make a smooth, thin mixture. After the milk has reduced a little, slowly add this mixture to the milk while continuously stirring.
Add the saffron water while the milk is cooking and continue stirring on a low flame.
Roast the makhana until crisp. Take ¼ cup of the roasted makhana and grind it into a fine powder.
Add the makhana powder to the milk and mix well. This will help thicken the milk and give it a creamy texture.
Add the remaining 70g roasted whole makhana along with the chopped almonds, cashews and pistachios. Mix everything well.
Add zero-calorie sweetener as per your taste and continue cooking on a low flame for a few more minutes.
Turn off the flame and let it cool. Transfer it to the fridge and chill for a few hours.
Serve chilled. You can optionally add rose petals or fruit pulp of your choice mango or sitaphal both go really well.
assumptions: The saffron and the milk powder are each mixed with a little water. The creator’s figures are approximate.
